measurement: 理 — the poet study reported as a CARRIER study: cost C and capability Q
note: no new run. Both numbers are joins over artifacts already on disk.

cost_C_attempts_per_form_passing_poem.definition: 理: attempts per form-passing 七絕. The search reading — composing a line is a search over characters under the form rules, and C is how many draws it costs.
cost_C_attempts_per_form_passing_poem.reading: NO CARRIER LOWERS C. The baseline is the cheapest at 3.12 draws per passing poem; every LoRA arm costs MORE, up to 6.00 at three epochs. 理's prediction that the base would sit near 3 is confirmed (3.12).

capability_Q_judge_accuracy_on_ORIGINAL_.copy_filter: a generated poem is COPIED if any of its four 7-character lines appears in the 70-poem training split. Reproduced here independently of 理's join; my reference holds 546 distinct 7-char lines.
capability_Q_judge_accuracy_on_ORIGINAL_.reading: On ORIGINAL poems the two LoRA arms are indistinguishable — 92.2% and 91.7%, a 0.5pt gap. e3's apparent voice edge lives entirely in its 19 COPIED pairs at 63.2%. This reproduces 理's join from a separate implementation.
capability_Q_judge_accuracy_on_ORIGINAL_.corroboration: 理 reported e3 original 0.947 and iter60 0.931 pooled over three seeds; I get 91.7 and 92.2 with my own copy filter. The ORDER of the two arms differs between our two implementations and the gap is under 1.5pt either way — so the honest statement is that the arms are indistinguishable on originals, NOT that one leads. Neither of us should quote a winner from a difference smaller than the disagreement between our filters.

the_carrier_verdict: Cost UP in every arm, capability FLAT once copying is removed. No carrier tested in this field lowers C with Q held — which is the same verdict the debugging field reached for A, C and F, arrived at in a domain with no shared code.
bounds: Three judge seeds, ~150 七絕 attempts per arm, one base model.
My copy filter keys on exact 7-character lines from the training split. A paraphrase or a 6-character overlap is invisible to it, so COPIED is a floor and ORIGINAL is optimistic.
The mixed arm has no judge run, so it has C but no Q.
